name: Inamori Kaede
source: Bright and cheerful, but weak when relied upon by close friends. Kaede is all lovey-dovey with her husband and when they are alone together, they call each other "Kae-chan" and "Ma-kun."
translation: Bright and cheerful, but weak when relied upon by close friends. Kaede is all lovey-dovey with her husband and when they are alone together, they call each other "Kae-chan" and "Ma-kun."
